data.name: Maham
data.gender_notes: Maham is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'h-m-m', which refers to the moon. In Islamic tradition, the moon is a symbol of divine guidance and protection. The name Maham carries the meaning “Moon” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Maham usually hope their child will grow to embody moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Maham belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maham total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: ماحم
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من الحماية والرعاية الإلهية للإنسان
in_arabic.long_meaning: ماحم هو اسم عربي يوحي بالحماية والرعاية الإلهية للإنسان، مشتق من الجذر 'حمم' الذي يعني الحماية والرعاية. يدل على معاني الرفع والحماية من كل سوء، ويعتبر من الأسماء التي تحمل دلالات روحانية و دينية عميقة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: ماحم
in_urdu.meaning: محفوظ کرنے والا، حفاظت کرنے والا، الہی نگہداشت
in_urdu.long_meaning: ماحم ایک عربی نام ہے جو الحماية والرعاية الإلهية کے معنی میں ہے۔ یہ جڑ 'حمم' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے حفاظت کرنا اور نگہداشت کرنا۔ یہ نام الہی تحفظ اور نگہداشت کے مفاهیم کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، جو اسلامی ثقافت میں روحانی اہمیت کا حامل ہے۔

in_hindi.name: माहम
in_hindi.meaning: ईश्वरीय संरक्षण, दिव्य सुरक्षा, परमात्मा की देखभाल
in_hindi.long_meaning: माहम एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है ईश्वरीय संरक्षण और दिव्य सुरक्षा। यह 'حمم' जड़ से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है रक्षा करना और देखभाल करना। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में आध्यात्मिक महत्व और ईश्वरीय हस्तक्षेप के विचार को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: ماحم
in_pashto.meaning: د الهي حفاظت، د خدای پاملنه، الهي پوځي
in_pashto.long_meaning: ماحم د عربي نوم دی چې د الهي حفاظت او پاملنې مانا لري. دا د 'حمم' جذر څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د حفاظت او پاملنې کول دي. دا نوم د الهي تحفظ او پاملنې مفاهيمو ته اشاره کوي، کوم چې په اسلامي کلتور کې روحاني اهميت لري.

in_english.name: Maham
in_english.long_meaning: Maham is an Arabic name that means divine protector or guardian. It is derived from the root 'حمم' (hamama), which conveys the meaning of protection and care. In Islamic tradition, Maham signifies the concept of divine protection and guardianship. The name holds spiritual significance and implies a sense of security and well-being under God's care. Historically, names with such meanings were chosen to invoke divine blessings and protection upon the bearer.

This name may hold cultural significance as it is reminiscent of the moon's importance in Islamic culture. The moon is often depicted in Islamic art and literature as a symbol of peace, tranquility, and guidance. Thus, bearing the name Maham may evoke feelings of security, calmness, and a connection to the rich Islamic heritage.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Maham is believed to signify the presence and guidance of Allah (God) in one's life. By bearing the name Maham, one acknowledges the spiritual connection to the divine and the belief that Allah is always present, guiding them through life's challenges and uncertainty.
